name: DarkEye_Lookup
author: DarkEye
description: Look up a domain in DarkEye: ransomware leaks, data breaches, leads and stealer logs listed for it by HaveIBeenRansom and Breach House. Needs an API key for at least one of the two products.

configurationItems.name: haveibeenransom_api_key
configurationItems.description: HaveIBeenRansom API key (haveibeenransom.com). Optional, but at least one of the two keys is needed.

configurationItems.name: breachhouse_api_key
configurationItems.description: Breach House API key (breach.house). Optional, but at least one of the two keys is needed.

configurationItems.name: max_pages
configurationItems.description: Maximum number of HaveIBeenRansom result pages to read (about 20 records per page, one API call each)

configurationItems.name: limit
configurationItems.description: Maximum number of Breach House records per source (ransomware, breaches, leads, stealers), 200 at most

configurationItems.name: max_records
configurationItems.description: Maximum number of records kept per product, which bounds the size of the report
